answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a raven that rotates unpredictably. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest zenith a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. The knoll is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal syc64.
